run_GPT_model: run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and optional targets to compute logits and loss
run_DistributedDataLoader: run the DistributedDataLoader to load and iterate over binary token data shards across distributed processes
build_GPTConfig: build a GPTConfig dataclass to configure block size, vocab size, number of layers, heads, and embedding dimensions
run_CausalSelfAttention: run the CausalSelfAttention module with rotary embeddings and scaled dot product attention on input tensors
run_rmsnorm: run the rmsnorm function to apply root mean square layer normalization to a tensor with configurable epsilon
